issue.title: Pause silently when the connection drops mid-upload [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios E.17, F.20)

## Summary

When the connection drops during an upload, the take is marked failed and the Sync page shows a raw technical error, instead of pausing silently.

The worker tries a network error 3 times (2 retries, 0.5 s and 1 s backoff), then marks the take failed (`src/services/recordingSync.ts:32`, `:276-317`, `src/services/verseAudioContract.ts:77-79`), before the connectivity event aborts the session. Network errors get no friendly mapping (`src/utils/sanitizeUploadError.ts:12-31`). Takes re-upload on reconnect, so no data is lost.

## Expected

"If the server becomes unreachable during an active upload, pause the upload silently — no user-facing error for the interruption itself" (#150).

## Actual

The Sync page shows "fetch failed: java.net.UnknownHostException: Unable to resolve host "dev.api.fluent.bible": No address associated with hostname"; it clears after the automatic retry when Wi-Fi returns.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start an upload of several takes on Wi-Fi.
2. Turn on airplane mode for 30 s, then turn it off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A network/transport failure during an upload leaves the take pending, not failed, and shows no error.
- [ ] The upload resumes on its own when the server is reachable.
- [ ] Any network error that does reach the UI has friendly copy.
- [ ] Unit test: network error during upload → pending, not failed.
- [ ] Android device QA (E.17).

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #150, #548
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
